title: Bayonetta 2
description: Bayonetta 2 expands PlatinumGames’ character-action formula with new weapons, Umbran Climax, refined combat pacing and spectacular environments. The campaign is primarily single-player, while Tag Climax supports two-player cooperative battles through local wireless or online play.

description_short: A critically acclaimed stylish-action sequel with faster set pieces, Umbran Climax and two-player Tag Climax battles.
description_ar: تكملة أكشن سريعة توسّع نظام Bayonetta بأسلحة جديدة وميزة Umbran Climax ومعارك أكثر ضخامة. القصة فردية أساسًا، بينما يوفّر طور Tag Climax مواجهات تعاونية للاعبين عبر الاتصال المحلي اللاسلكي أو الإنترنت.
nintendoNotes: Native Nintendo Switch release dated February 16, 2018. gameplayPillars.title: Refined Witch Time
gameplayPillars.description: Perfect dodges slow enemies and create openings for high-damage combo routes.

gameplayPillars.title: Umbran Climax
gameplayPillars.description: Spend magic to amplify attacks and summon large Wicked Weaves throughout a combo.

gameplayPillars.title: Weapon Variety
gameplayPillars.description: Mix hand and foot weapon sets to create distinct combo properties and playstyles.

gameplayPillars.title: Tag Climax

worldSummary: Bayonetta travels through Noatun and realms including Paradiso and Inferno while attempting to rescue Jeanne’s soul. The journey deepens the series’ mythology and brings Bayonetta into direct conflict with angels, demons and masked rivals.

storyChapters.title: Jeanne’s Soul
storyChapters.body: After a catastrophic battle, Jeanne’s soul is dragged toward Inferno and Bayonetta sets out to save her.

storyChapters.title: Journey to Fimbulventr
storyChapters.body: Bayonetta travels through Noatun toward the sacred mountain while confronting angels, demons and a masked Lumen Sage.

storyChapters.title: Aesir and the Eyes
storyChapters.body: The story explores the origins of the Eyes of the World and the god Aesir.

storyChapters.title: Across Time
storyChapters.body: Events connect Bayonetta’s past and present and expand the mythology established by the first game.

perfNotes: The Switch version uses 720p in both docked and handheld modes and targets 60 fps. Docked performance is generally stronger; demanding scenes can still fall below the target.

handheld.notes: Portable mode renders at 720p and targets 60 fps. Complex combat can fall below the target, with handheld performance generally less consistent than docked.

tv.notes: Docked mode renders at 720p and targets 60 fps, with improved performance compared with the Wii U release but not a perfect locked 60 fps.

faq.q: Does Bayonetta 2 work on Nintendo Switch 2?
faq.a: Yes through backward compatibility where Nintendo marks the Nintendo Switch release as supported. This file does not classify it as a native Nintendo Switch 2 Edition.

faq.q: What language is the supplier version of Bayonetta 2?
faq.a: Supplier listing language supplied by the user: Simplified Chinese. Official/regional language details are preserved separately in supported_languages_raw and nintendo_notes so the supplier SKU is not generalized to every region.
Yes. The file records the supported local/online modes individually.

faq.q: Why are some Switch 2 performance resolution fields blank for Bayonetta 2?
faq.a: Because exact measured Switch 2 backward-compatibility rendering values were not verified. The template is intentionally left blank rather than filled with hardware maximums or guesses.

verdictSummary: One of the strongest modern character-action games, combining fluid combat, excellent encounter pacing and enormous spectacle. The Switch version’s 720p presentation is modest, but its portability and strong performance make it a particularly good Nintendo release.
